signature: Editorial calm: words resolve from blur in reading order; one object at a time resolves from blur at centre; exits blur and dim; continuity transitions (expand, focus) only when the next visual continues the same object.

transitions.expand: card grows into the demo of the same item (same scene)
transitions.focus: camera pushes into a detail of the current object
transitions.push: between numbered items (object exits left, next enters right)
